source.description:
PROBLEM: pruneConflictingPiPackagesFromSettings currently suppresses malformed JSON parse errors and silently skips cleanup. This can hide configuration repair failures.

SCOPE: cli/src/core/pi-runtime.ts cleanup reader and focused tests.

SUCCESS: Malformed Pi settings are preserved and produce an actionable warning/error without changing package cleanup behavior.

NON_GOALS: Do not alter valid settings migration semantics or global/project scope policy.

CONSTRAINTS: Preserve dry-run non-write behavior.

VALIDATION: Focused Pi runtime tests for malformed input and valid cleanup.

OUTPUT: Minimal hardening diff and test evidence.
source.title: Harden malformed Pi settings cleanup diagnostics
